verdict.rationale: LibreChat's own surface is an official, self-hosted web app with rich features beyond basic chat (agents, MCP tools, file handling), plus a public demo instance. Its docs state it is a web app and not a desktop installer, and no mobile app is evidenced, so the multi-surface part of the story is not delivered. Missing for 10: official desktop app, official mobile app, documented feature parity across surfaces, independent corroboration of a cross-device experience.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant also meets me in official web, desktop, or mobile apps with feature parity beyond the chat basics
